image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a large common iguana resting in grassy vegetation. The image focuses on the head, neck, and upper torso. The iguana displays a prominent dorsal crest with reddish-brown spines, textured grey-green scales, and a large circular subtympanic shield. The background is blurred foliage.
